subject.title: feat(auth): support configurable session cookie names

question: Should ClickClack support custom server session-cookie names when enabling the setting requires upgraded desktop clients and older desktop releases will fail OAuth against that server?
rationale: The implementation can preserve the default behavior, but deciding whether the opt-in operational benefit justifies a version-dependent desktop authentication contract is a product and compatibility choice rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Approve with proof and guidance
options.body: Accept the opt-in contract while requiring packaged-desktop proof and clear server/client upgrade documentation before merge.

options.title: Require a compatibility bridge
options.body: Hold the PR until the design supports older desktop clients during a defined migration period, accepting additional implementation and security complexity.

options.title: Decline the new setting
options.body: Keep one fixed session-cookie name and require operators to isolate services by hostname instead.

recommendation.title: Approve with proof and guidance
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in contract while requiring packaged-desktop proof and clear server/client upgrade documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice affects the supported server configuration and desktop authentication compatibility contract across releases.
